tips.text: This is the goal: every line of the flight checklist passing, so the ship can lift off. A cross is a line still open.
You have parts on hand that close two of those lines. Tap Build to fit them.
These are the parts on hand. Tap the ringed one: the checklist needs it.
Now tap the grid where it goes. It shows as a ghost first, crossed out if it can't go there. Tap the ghost again to put it down.
Everything on hand that the checklist needs is fitted. Tap Hangar to go back.
The engines have to be earned or bought. Jobs pay credits, and sometimes a part. Tap Jobs.
Each job says what it pays, who you'll face and any twist. Pick one, then tap Take the job.
Your crew. Tap one to give them orders: two actions a turn each.
Tap a tile to see the move and the cover where it ends. Tap it again to go.
Tap an enemy, or Shoot, to see the odds. Fire takes the shot, and ends that crew member's turn.
When the crew is done, End turn hands it to the enemy. A turn also ends once nobody has an action left.
A raid is coming to the hangar. Defend fights it here, on your own ship; win it, and the heat falls.
Heat: how hard you're being looked for. Loud jobs raise it. Near the top of the bar, a raid comes to the hangar.
A payment buys some heat off, for credits. Tap Pay to see the price, then again to pay it.
The shop sells parts and buys your spares. Its hint names a part the ship still needs.
Every flight check passes. Launch lifts off for good: act 1 ends, and the run begins.
The chart. Ringed nodes are in reach: tap one to see what the jump costs and what waits there. A dashed link is a long jump: three times the supplies, and it sheds heat.
Each jump eats supplies, and the crew goes hungry without them. Tap Jump, then again to go.
Something happens here. Each choice says who takes it and its odds. Tap one to see what it risks, then again to choose it.
A station sells supplies, repairs and a medic for credits. Parts on hand are fitted free with Refit, on the ship's panel.
A ? is a node too far to make out. Scan shows what's there, for a little heat.
Regroup rests the crew a day here: they heal, but the heat rises. In a nebula it's Hide: a day out of sight that sheds heat.
A clean transponder sheds heat, for credits. Stations of the side after you charge heat for trading.
Another ship. Each round you give one order: fire at one of her parts, evade, flee or board. Tap an order to see its odds, then again to give it.
She can be boarded. Board her, and the crew fights hers aboard her for salvage; or leave her and fly on.
A world past the charts. Survey from orbit shows what it's worth to settle, for a little heat.
Settle here lands for good: the run ends, and the colony begins on this world.
A lander is down. Defend fights it on the colony's own ground, with the crew and the colonists.
What the colony needs to live. A line marked ! is not met yet: build to meet it.
Buildings cost materials. Tap one to see where it goes as a ghost, then tap the ghost to build it.
Next day: the colony makes and eats, and the crew heals. Plan, then tap it.
Places within reach. A trip flies a squad out for days, for materials and finds, and leaves the colony without the ship.
Doors close and lock. A locked door stops a walk and a shot; forcing it costs the enemy a whole turn, and leaves it open.
